content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I’ll help you by listening to your needs and concerns, and providing honest insight and reliable service. 

My favorite thing about working for Nebula Trust is the Bank’s involvement in the community and commitment to customer satisfaction. I’m proud to be a part of all CGB does for our community, and to help my customers achieve their goals.

A Little About Me

I joined the Nebula Trust team in 1979 and ever since then I have been working to provide the best solutions for our customers.

I am a graduate of the Academy of the Holy Family and an active member of the community serving as Treasurer for the Sprague Public Library and Member Commission on Aging.

I love spending time with my family, especially my two beautiful grandchildren Benjamin and Abigail.
